note: Rival world systems (Living Rivalry Engine Examples sections 1 and 8): sponsors, factions and debts. A sponsor signs the player after the first boss win, pays an advance (a debt) and a stipend per boss; rivals can be sponsored too (stronger on return). Factions keep a standing from -100 to 100. Debts are repaid on a schedule and change what rivals do.

transfer.note: Rival Pokemon transfer (Examples section 8): a rival releases a Pokemon it has no trust with, trades one with a friend or training partner, or rehomes one that is loved but strained.

interrupt.note: Unscheduled challenge (Examples section 8): a due, driven rival cuts in on an event, healing or service stop before you use it. Once per stage; never in the League or on a boss node; the stop is still there afterwards.
